metadata.title: Meta's strong results aren't helping the stocks of its hyperscaler peers - MarketWatch

content.text:
8 hours ago
Meta's strong results aren't helping the stocks of its hyperscaler peers
While Meta's earnings are providing a nice boost to its stock, the results are not providing a boost to share of other AI hyperscalers.
Amazon's stock was up just 0.1% in after-hours trading, while Microsoft shares were down 0.1% and Alphabet's stock was inching up less than 0.1%.
